numerical_findings.explanation: Both endpoints of step [15.50, 15.55] s have static clearance >= 0.150098 m, but the straight-line chord between them passes closer to the static gate corner/edge (interior minimum at 0.149811 m). Because DWA only checks static obstacles pointwise at endpoints, it saw 0.150098 m >= 0.150000 m and accepted the trajectory.
